race.title: Denise Smith Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: NOWHERENEARMILAN steps up to 3m for first time and could be worth a chance in a thin race. Makinbecon and Dublinofficecallin appeal most of those with handicap form. NOWHERENEARMILAN (IRE) MAKINBECON DUBLINOFFICECALLIN
